title: Lunch After Science
setting: A small cafe near the school with a long green table.

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans)

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Omar
characters.look: Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron)

sentences.en: After science class, Mia and Ben feel hungry.
sentences.zh: 上完科学课，米娅和本饿了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) walk out of a school science room with test tubes on the tables, holding their tummies.
sentences.narration: Mia and Ben walk out of a school science room with test tubes on the tables, holding their tummies.

sentence_targets.en: Study of the natural world through observation and experiments

sentences.en: The special today is bread with meat and cheese.
sentences.zh: 今天的特色菜是夹肉和奶酪的面包。
sentences.scene_prompt: At the cafe counter, Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron) proudly holds up a plate of bread with meat and cheese.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Omar offering bread with meat and cheese; that it is today's special can't be shown.
sentences.narration: At the cafe counter, Omar proudly holds up a plate of bread with meat and cheese.

sentence_targets.en: Different from usual, often in an important or valued way.
The flesh of animals eaten as food.
A food made by pressing or ripening the solids of milk.

sentences.en: Ben pays for two plates at the counter.
sentences.zh: 本在柜台付了两份的钱。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) hands coins to Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron) at the cafe counter while Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) waits.
sentences.narration: Ben hands coins to Omar at the cafe counter while Mia waits.

sentence_targets.en: To give money for something or for someone's work

sentences.en: He carries them slowly to a long green table.
sentences.zh: 他慢慢地把它们端到一张长长的绿桌子旁。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) carefully carries two plates toward a long green table in the cafe.
sentences.narration: Ben carefully carries two plates toward a long green table in the cafe.

sentence_targets.en: At a low speed or over a long time.
Hold or support something while moving it somewhere
Having the colour of grass and most leaves.
Extending a great distance or lasting a great time.

sentences.en: An old policeman with white hair sits there.
sentences.zh: 一位白发的老警察坐在那里。
sentences.scene_prompt: At the long green table sits an old policeman with white hair, glasses and a blue uniform, eating soup.
sentences.narration: At the long green table sits an old policeman with white hair, glasses and a blue uniform, eating soup.

sentence_targets.en: Thin strands growing on the skin of people and animals.
Having lived or existed for a long time.

sentences.en: His glasses fall on the floor.
sentences.scene_prompt: A pair of glasses falls from the face of an old policeman with white hair, glasses and a blue uniform onto the cafe floor.
sentences.narration: A pair of glasses falls from the face of an old policeman with white hair, glasses and a blue uniform onto the cafe floor.

sentence_targets.en: Two lenses in a frame worn to improve sight.

sentences.en: Mia picks them up for the kind man.
sentences.zh: 米娅为这位和善的老人捡起眼镜。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) hands the glasses back to an old policeman with white hair, glasses and a blue uniform.
sentences.narration: Mia hands the glasses back to an old policeman with white hair, glasses and a blue uniform.

sentence_targets.en: Caring about others and willing to help them.

sentences.en: “Thank you!” he calls, with a big smile.
sentences.zh: “谢谢你！”他大声说，笑得很开心。
sentences.scene_prompt: An old policeman with white hair, glasses and a blue uniform smiles widely and waves at Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts).
sentences.draw_note: Shows the old man smiling and waving; his words can't be shown.
sentences.narration: An old policeman with white hair, glasses and a blue uniform smiles widely and waves at Mia and Ben.

sentence_targets.en: To telephone someone or shout to get their attention.
